fields.statement: The implementation handoff begins with one lean outcome-first `/goal` that references adopted local authority and uses deterministic progressive disclosure instead of requiring all registries in startup context.
fields.validator: Goal length, required-section, authority-reference, context-router, duplicate-rule, and wholesale-registry-load checks.
fields.independent_proof: A fresh root reconstructs the active-node authority set and begins correct work without hidden chat or loading unrelated registries.
completion_blockers: goal copies granular registries or repeated laws
startup requires full requirement, surface, tool, or claim registries without a global-boundary reason
fresh root misses required authority because routing is incomplete

requirement.statement: A versioned context-routing map selects exact node, requirement, surface, tool, claim, migration, research, decision, and evidence rows by stable ID while unloaded adopted rows remain authoritative.
requirement.implementation_scope: goal bootstrap, context routing, and stable-ID selection
requirement.validator: Routing-map schema, graph-closure, stable-ID resolution, deterministic ordering, unknown-row, duplicate-row, conflict, and same-session revalidation checks.
requirement.independent_proof: For representative active-node sets, selected rows equal the dependency-closed oracle and unrelated registries are not loaded.
completion_blockers: missing selected authority
unknown or duplicate stable ID accepted
unloaded row treated as non-authoritative
selection not rebound before claim use

requirement.statement: The root allocates substantial dependency-closed work packages, permits at most one implementation lane per node, and uses small slices only for dangerous boundaries, shared typed interfaces, multi-node unblockers, or falsified assumptions.
requirement.implementation_scope: root planning, lease allocation, lane ownership, and integration cadence
requirement.validator: Active-lease node ownership, overlap, dependency-closure, package-size rationale, and root-integration-latency checks.
requirement.independent_proof: Interrupted, blocked, and concurrent scenarios show one implementation owner per node, useful concurrency on independent nodes, and prompt root integration of accepted sets.
completion_blockers: two implementation lanes own one node
micro-slicing has no allowed rationale
accepted candidate waits behind administrative integration
busywork created to simulate concurrency

requirement.statement: Rolling review is frozen-artifact-set-specific and returns REWORK after the first decisive material defect; comprehensive multi-role full-scope review runs only at the exact integrated claim boundary that requires it.
requirement.implementation_scope: review materiality, early termination, corrective review, and final integrated falsification
requirement.validator: Review-stage, artifact-set, first-material-defect, reviewer-independence, corrected-set identity, and exact-boundary full-team checks.
requirement.independent_proof: A seeded material defect stops redundant review, correction receives fresh exact-set review, and final integrated sign-off still invokes every contract-required role.
completion_blockers: review continues after decisive REWORK without a separate purpose
corrected bytes reuse stale review
final required role omitted
routine patch forced through completion-wide review

requirement.statement: Candidate-source review remains read-only; executable reproduction that needs writes uses a separate independent ephemeral scratch-only verification lease, and unavailable scratch execution is labeled supplied-only with a lower ceiling.
requirement.implementation_scope: review sandbox, scratch target isolation, executable evidence, and supplied-only ceilings
requirement.validator: Candidate-write denial, scratch allowlist, isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR, candidate binding, cleanup, provenance, and supplied-only ceiling checks.
requirement.independent_proof: A verifier reproduces focused tests without changing candidate bytes or Git state; denied scratch capability cannot be misreported as independently reproduced.
completion_blockers: reviewer writes candidate source
scratch output escapes lease
supplied test output called independent reproduction
build evidence not bound to frozen candidate

requirement.statement: Static project-agent prompts contain only stable role and least-privilege invariants; every invocation binds an exact AgentTaskEnvelope-v1 rather than copying node, claim, or review authority into the role prompt.
requirement.implementation_scope: agent manifests, task envelopes, review packets, and discovery
requirement.validator: AgentTaskEnvelope-v1 schema, exact-scope expansion, role identity, forbidden duplicate authority, private-data leakage, and opaque-scope rejection checks.
requirement.independent_proof: Each canonical agent receives two different exact tasks without changing its static role prompt and rejects missing, stale, ambiguous, or over-authorized envelopes.
completion_blockers: static prompt duplicates registry law
full_current_scope has no exact expansion
task envelope omits effects or false-pass controls
agent conclusion treated as claim authority

requirement.statement: Compatibility skill and agent prompts are generated from one minimal non-authoritative route template, excluded from canonical workflow counts, and retired under measured migration proof.
requirement.implementation_scope: compatibility prompt generation, routing, discovery classification, measurement, and retirement
requirement.validator: Single-template generation, canonical-count exclusion, target availability, ambiguity rejection, no-hidden-effect, active-reference, compatibility-window, and retirement checks.
requirement.independent_proof: Legacy invocations preserve input and reach one canonical route during the adopted window; ordinary discovery selects canonical skills; retired aliases have no active reader or writer.
completion_blockers: wrapper defines independent workflow authority
wrapper prose drifts from generator
legacy route wins canonical selection
alias removed before adopted retirement proof

requirement.statement: Prompt and context changes are promoted only after representative evaluations compare the same outcome contract across supported task-shape configurations and measure behavior, false passes, cost, and context load.
requirement.implementation_scope: prompt evaluation matrix, routing accuracy, behavior quality, cost, context load, and promotion
requirement.validator: Prompt identity, runtime-metadata provenance, representative task coverage, paired comparison, negative-control, scorer-validity, cost, and guarded non-regression checks.
requirement.independent_proof: Typed-transform, routine-engineering, deep-judgment, and parallel-orchestration tasks show supported behavior without model-name inference or prompt-specific scoring rewards.
completion_blockers: static prompt review substituted for behavior eval
different prompts confound model comparison
runtime label inferred
score improves while representative behavior regresses

requirement.statement: The CLI validates prompt, skill, agent, task-envelope, context-route, and automation structure for exact ownership, resolved authority, least privilege, private-data safety, and false-pass controls rather than accepting non-empty prose alone.
requirement.implementation_scope: typed prompt and routing validation plus red fixtures
requirement.validator: Schema, stable-ID, duplicate-law, opaque-scope, inferred-runtime, sandbox/effect, private-data, generated-template, stale-candidate, and false-pass checks.
requirement.independent_proof: Malformed, vague, contradictory, over-authorized, leaking, stale, and prompt-inferred fixtures fail causally while exact lean envelopes pass without requiring verbose prose.
completion_blockers: non-empty prompt accepted despite missing task contract
duplicate law owner accepted
private prompt or sensitive path packaged
prompt text used as runtime proof

required_root_actions: reopen affected evidence and run independent review

no_claim_statement: This proposed patch is not adopted authority and does not claim implementation, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
